description: Sixteen-channel bridge between the patch and an audio device, sending sixteen signals out to it and bringing sixteen back

inputs.text: Sent to the audio device's output channel of that number, 10V being full scale

outputs.text: Carries the audio device's input channel of that number, full scale arriving as 10V

notes: no sound passes until an audio device is chosen; a new one comes up on the first driver in the list with no device at all
the lamp beside a pair of jacks is green while the chosen device has those two channels, and red for a quarter of a second after the signal passes full scale
the driver, device, sample rate and block size are picked by left-clicking the four lines of the display, each of which opens a menu of its own; none of them is on the panel's right-click menu
a larger block size makes dropouts less likely and adds latency of that many samples
menu: Master audio module — makes this module drive the engine's timing, so the patch runs at the rate of its device
DC blocker — strips any constant offset from the signals sent to the device, and starts unset on this module
